column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 27 (E99015): pecahan ingatan Igla soal gadis pirang mulai muncul;
# dia diam-diam menyelidiki Girard Group dan insiden Lviv di arsip Mangi Security.
# Tetap Inggris: Mangi Security, Mokosh, Igla, Ruchey, Commander, Lentine, Girard Group,
# Cecht FABN, Odesa, Oleg Girard, Paradise Project, Project Elysium, Lviv, Boojum,
# Neural cloud, Frame, Doll, Green Zone, White Zone, Yellow Zone.
(The blocked passage door and wall turn to ash in a loud bang. Mangi Security squad members file in, hurriedly clearing out the last resistance point in the Mokosh command center.)
column2: (Pintu dan dinding lorong yang tersumbat itu jadi abu dalam satu dentuman keras. Anggota regu Mangi Security berbaris masuk, buru-buru membersihkan titik perlawanan terakhir di pusat komando Mokosh.)

column1: Everyone, hand over your weapons and cease resistance!
column2: Semuanya, serahkan senjata kalian dan hentikan perlawanan!

column1: Tsk, all of you squat in the corner! Hurry up, don't delay my squad's withdrawal!
column2: Cih, kalian semua jongkok di sudut! Cepat, jangan menunda penarikan reguku!

column1: (The battle is nearing its end, and the outcome is no longer in suspense. The members of Mangi Security inevitably show some anxiety or joy, and the cleanup operation becomes increasingly impatient.)
column2: (Pertempurannya mendekati akhir, dan hasilnya sudah tidak menegangkan lagi. Anggota Mangi Security mau tak mau memperlihatkan sedikit kegelisahan atau kegembiraan, dan operasi pembersihannya jadi makin tidak sabar.)

column1: (However, outside the swiftly moving, joyful crowd, a blonde figure in red stands at the edge of the rubble and ashes, seemingly deaf to the orders, stiffly silent.)
column2: (Namun di luar kerumunan yang bergerak cepat dan riang itu, sebuah figur pirang berpakaian merah berdiri di tepi puing dan abu, seolah tuli terhadap perintah, diam dengan kaku.)

column1: (The battle before her seems to have nothing to do with her, and the joy or noise of the people around her cannot disturb her in the slightest. Only a scene that happened not long ago keeps replaying in her Neural cloud like an error program—)
column2: (Pertempuran di depannya seolah tidak ada kaitannya dengan dirinya, dan kegembiraan atau keriuhan orang di sekitarnya sedikit pun tidak mengganggunya. Hanya satu adegan yang terjadi belum lama ini terus berputar di Neural cloud-nya seperti program yang galat—)

column1: This is not the end... Ruchey!
column2: Ini belum berakhir... Ruchey!

column1: (That Doll squad belonging to the Commander intercepted the attack of her Mangi Security team near the Mokosh command center, and she fought them according to her orders.)
column2: (Regu Doll milik Commander itu mencegat serangan tim Mangi Security-nya di dekat pusat komando Mokosh, dan dia melawan mereka sesuai perintahnya.)

column1: (The opponent naturally failed, but the two light, bouncing, curly braids behind one of the Dolls' heads lingered in her neural cloud like a piece of anomalous code.)
column2: (Lawannya tentu saja gagal, tapi dua kepang keriting yang ringan dan memantul di belakang kepala salah satu Doll itu tertinggal di neural cloud-nya seperti sepotong kode yang ganjil.)

column1: (It was as if she had often seen a similar scene in the past, as if she had once known someone who wore two curly braids—)
column2: (Seolah dia sering melihat pemandangan serupa di masa lalu, seolah dia pernah mengenal seseorang yang memakai dua kepang keriting—)

column1: (In a luxurious mansion, she seemed to have once combed that person's hair. The golden strands danced between her fingers like a vibrant ray of sunlight.)
column2: (Di sebuah rumah besar yang mewah, dia seolah pernah menyisir rambut orang itu. Helai-helai emas itu menari di antara jarinya seperti seberkas sinar matahari yang penuh gairah.)

column1: Igla, how long are you going to keep combing?
column2: Igla, kau mau menyisir sampai kapan?

column1: ███, please be patient.
column2: ███, mohon bersabar.

column1: Your hair has grown quite a bit recently. Adding some curls to your braids will make it look more beautiful.
column2: Rambut Anda belakangan ini tumbuh cukup banyak. Menambahkan sedikit ikal pada kepangnya akan membuatnya tampak lebih cantik.

column1: Hmm, really? I wonder if Father will notice if I change to a new hairstyle...
column2: Hmm, benarkah? Entah apa Ayah akan menyadarinya kalau aku ganti gaya rambut baru...

column1: Please don't worry. Besides the new hairstyle, I have also prepared hair accessories that match you.
column2: Mohon jangan khawatir. Selain gaya rambut baru, saya juga menyiapkan aksesori rambut yang cocok untuk Anda.

column1: Once the final touches are complete, you will definitely be the most radiant star at the banquet.
column2: Begitu sentuhan terakhirnya selesai, Anda pasti akan jadi bintang paling bersinar di jamuan itu.

column1: (In a brand-new laboratory, she seemed to have once tidied up that person's appearance.)
column2: (Di sebuah laboratorium yang benar-benar baru, dia seolah pernah merapikan penampilan orang itu.)

column1: Waaah! My clothes are all wet! Igla! Hurry up and help me change out of this lab coat!
column2: Huwaaa! Bajuku basah semua! Igla! Cepat bantu aku ganti jas lab ini!
Baik, ███.

column1: (The clothes dirtied by knocking over lab equipment are methodically cleaned up and replaced by her. The golden braids are carefully gathered and let down, falling over the new clothes that emit a faint fragrance.)
column2: (Pakaian yang kotor karena menjatuhkan peralatan lab itu dibersihkan dan diganti olehnya dengan tertib. Kepang emas itu dikumpulkan dengan hati-hati lalu diurai, jatuh di atas pakaian baru yang mengeluarkan wangi samar.)

column1: Hmph... You seem to be getting more and more skilled, Igla.
column2: Hmph... Sepertinya kau makin lama makin mahir, Igla.

column1: Saving you time is my duty as a ██.
column2: Menghemat waktu Anda adalah tugas saya sebagai ██.

column1: You have made a remarkable discovery here. If Lord ███ were to see this, he would definitely be proud of you.
column2: Anda membuat temuan yang luar biasa di sini. Kalau Tuan ███ melihatnya, beliau pasti akan bangga pada Anda.

column1: Hmph! Of course! My invention can change the world!
column2: Hmph! Tentu saja! Penemuanku bisa mengubah dunia!

column1: Igla, after you change your clothes, bring those documents over. I must figure out this problem today!
column2: Igla, setelah kau ganti baju, bawa dokumen itu kemari. Hari ini aku harus memecahkan masalah ini!

column1: Hey, I'm calling you, what are you spacing out for!
column2: Hei, aku memanggilmu, kenapa malah bengong!

column1: (An impatient shout explodes in Igla's ear. Igla snaps back to reality as the members of the Mangi Security squad walk out escorting prisoners, issuing new orders to her.)
column2: (Teriakan tidak sabar meledak di telinga Igla. Igla tersentak kembali ke kenyataan saat anggota regu Mangi Security keluar mengawal tahanan, sembari melemparkan perintah baru padanya.)

column1: A communications squad escaped towards the back door passage. We don't have enough backup, you follow them!
column2: Satu regu komunikasi kabur ke arah lorong pintu belakang. Bala bantuan kami tidak cukup, kau kejar mereka!

column1: (Igla remains silent. The touch of gold in her Neural cloud seems to still be dancing, making her Frame stiff and her footsteps sluggish, making her instinctively resist the other party's commands as if she had been "awakened".)
column2: (Igla tetap diam. Sentuhan warna emas di Neural cloud-nya seolah masih menari, membuat Frame-nya kaku dan langkahnya berat, membuatnya secara insting menolak perintah pihak itu seolah dia baru "terbangun".)

column1: Tch... Did you hear me? This is an order!
column2: Cih... Kau dengar aku? Ini perintah!

column1: ("Orders.")
column2: ("Perintah.")

column1: (Like an incantation, a more powerful tide surges within her neural cloud, washing away the 'illusions' that are so out of place with the flames of war beside her.)
column2: (Seperti mantra, pasang yang lebih kuat menyembur di neural cloud-nya, menyapu bersih 'ilusi' yang begitu tidak selaras dengan kobaran perang di sisinya.)

column1: (The shattered emotions are completely washed away by the tide, and the thoughts of resistance are cleared out along with them. Igla drags her frame, lowers her head slightly, and slowly takes a step in the direction the soldier pointed.)
column2: (Emosi yang berkeping-keping itu tersapu habis oleh pasang tersebut, dan pikiran untuk melawan ikut terbersihkan. Igla menyeret frame-nya, menundukkan kepala sedikit, dan perlahan melangkah ke arah yang ditunjuk tentara itu.)

column1: ...Understood.
column2: ...Dimengerti.

column1: (The pungent smell of gunpowder smoke filled the dark passage. The rubble strewn across the ground, along with the occasionally falling sand and gravel, forced the people in the passage to walk carefully and slowly.)
column2: (Bau menyengat asap mesiu memenuhi lorong yang gelap itu. Puing yang berserakan di lantai, ditambah pasir dan kerikil yang sesekali jatuh, memaksa orang-orang di lorong itu berjalan hati-hati dan lambat.)

column1: (However, with Igla clearing the way ahead, Mangi Security's pursuit team easily overcame the obstacles and rapidly charged deeper.)
column2: (Namun dengan Igla membuka jalan di depan, tim pengejar Mangi Security dengan mudah melewati penghalangnya dan cepat menerobos lebih dalam.)

column1: (That fleeing comms squad was also quickly caught up to.)
column2: (Regu komunikasi yang kabur itu juga cepat tersusul.)

column1: Catch them!
column2: Tangkap mereka!

column1: (As soon as the fleeing figures appeared ahead, the Mangi Security squad leader quickly instructed Igla to pursue.)
column2: (Begitu figur-figur yang kabur itu muncul di depan, pemimpin regu Mangi Security cepat memerintahkan Igla mengejar.)

column1: (But Igla's actions were faster than the order—)
column2: (Tapi gerakan Igla lebih cepat dari perintahnya—)

column1: (The red figure leaps up, flashing behind the crowd like a phantom. The sword light cuts through the burning black smoke and slashes down toward the weapons raised by the opponents.)
column2: (Figur merah itu melompat, berkelebat di belakang kerumunan seperti hantu. Kilau pedangnya membelah asap hitam yang membara dan menebas turun ke arah senjata yang diangkat lawannya.)
（Sret!）

column1: (Swish! Swish! Swish!)
column2: (Sret! Sret! Sret!)

column1: (Before the gun barrels could even be raised, they were sliced in two, and more weapons were knocked away one by one by Igla.)
column2: (Bahkan sebelum laras-laras itu sempat terangkat, semuanya terpotong dua, dan lebih banyak senjata ditepis satu per satu oleh Igla.)

column1: (With almost no suspense, Igla disarmed the opponents with overwhelming superiority and took control of the squad. But just as Igla was about to sheathe her sword, something caught her eye—)
column2: (Nyaris tanpa ketegangan, Igla melucuti senjata lawannya dengan keunggulan yang telak dan menguasai regu itu. Tapi tepat saat Igla hendak menyarungkan pedangnya, sesuatu menarik matanya—)

column1: (It was a plush toy lying on the ground.)
column2: (Itu boneka berbulu yang tergeletak di lantai.)

column1: (The toy had clearly been left behind for a long time. Dirty cotton spilled out from its torn seams, and its originally soft plush was messily matted together in the damp, dark tunnel, turning into clumps.)
column2: (Boneka itu jelas sudah lama ditinggalkan. Kapas kotor meluber dari jahitannya yang robek, dan bulunya yang semula lembut kusut berantakan di terowongan yang lembap dan gelap itu, menggumpal jadi bongkahan.)

column1: (No one knew who its owner was or when it was left here. It was only because Igla's attack sliced open the stone slab pressing on it that it was able to 'see the light of day' again.)
column2: (Tidak ada yang tahu siapa pemiliknya atau kapan itu ditinggalkan di situ. Hanya karena serangan Igla membelah lempeng batu yang menindihnya, boneka itu bisa kembali 'melihat cahaya'.)

column1: (It should have been an ordinary plush toy, a classic model that was once a huge bestseller in the Green Zone and White Zone, loved by countless children, so its appearance in this small Yellow Zone city was not unusual.)
column2: (Itu seharusnya boneka berbulu biasa, model klasik yang dulu laris besar di Green Zone dan White Zone, dicintai anak-anak yang tak terhitung, jadi kemunculannya di kota kecil Yellow Zone ini bukan hal aneh.)

column1: (But Igla's movements involuntarily stopped.)
column2: (Tapi gerakan Igla berhenti tanpa dia sadari.)

column1: (In her neural cloud, a certain blurry image seemed to surface once again—)
column2: (Di neural cloud-nya, sebuah citra yang kabur seolah kembali muncul—)

column1: (In the bedroom at night, dim and warm light shines on the blonde girl. It is late at night, but the girl refuses to sleep, just hugging the soft and cute doll in her arms, unwillingly pressing her face against the glass and looking out the window.)
column2: (Di kamar tidur pada malam hari, cahaya redup dan hangat menyorot gadis pirang itu. Malam sudah larut, tapi gadis itu menolak tidur, hanya memeluk boneka yang lembut dan manis di pelukannya, dengan enggan menempelkan wajahnya ke kaca dan menatap keluar jendela.)

column1: Igla, is Father still not coming back tonight?
column2: Igla, apa Ayah malam ini tetap tidak pulang?

column1: ...Apologies, ███. Master ███ has important matters tonight and I'm afraid he won't be able to return as promised.
column2: ...Mohon maaf, ███. Tuan ███ ada urusan penting malam ini dan sepertinya beliau tidak bisa pulang sesuai janji.

column1: But please rest assured, I will stay here to accompany you. If you feel lonely because of this—
column2: Tapi mohon tenang, saya akan tinggal di sini menemani Anda. Kalau Anda merasa kesepian karena itu—

column1: Hmph! I am a genius, I won't feel lonely over something like this!
column2: Hmph! Aku ini genius, aku tidak akan kesepian karena hal seperti itu!

column1: Besides... it's so late, the matters Father has to handle must be very important. As his daughter, of course I will be understanding!
column2: Lagi pula... sudah selarut ini, urusan yang harus Ayah tangani pasti sangat penting. Sebagai putrinya, tentu aku akan memaklumi!

column1: (The girl smiled, but unconsciously hugged the doll in her arms tighter. She still seemed unwilling to sleep, just standing by the window waiting for a long time. It wasn't until time passed minute by minute, and the irresistible drowsiness finally struck, that she reluctantly turned her gaze to the person guarding by the bed.)
column2: (Gadis itu tersenyum, tapi tanpa sadar memeluk bonekanya lebih erat. Dia tetap tampak enggan tidur, hanya berdiri di jendela menunggu lama sekali. Baru setelah waktu berlalu menit demi menit, dan kantuk yang tak tertahankan akhirnya menyerang, dia dengan berat hati mengalihkan tatapannya ke orang yang berjaga di sisi ranjang.)

column1: Mmm... I have to get up early tomorrow to meet those annoying reporters... I, I'll just take a short nap before Father comes back...
column2: Mmm... besok aku harus bangun pagi untuk menemui wartawan yang menyebalkan itu... a-aku tidur sebentar saja sebelum Ayah pulang...

column1: Igla, I order you to stay by my side. If Father comes back, you must wake me up immediately!
column2: Igla, aku perintahkan kau tetap di sisiku. Kalau Ayah pulang, kau harus segera membangunkanku!

column1: Understood, my ███.
column2: Dimengerti, ███ saya.

column1: (In the warm yellow light, she tucked the soft quilt around the girl, watching over her as she fell into a deep sleep.)
column2: (Di bawah cahaya kuning yang hangat, dia menyelimuti gadis itu dengan selimut yang lembut, menungguinya sampai tertidur lelap.)

column1: (A classic best-selling plush toy from the White Zone was held tightly in the girl's arms, contrasting with her smooth blonde hair...)
column2: (Boneka berbulu laris klasik dari White Zone itu dipeluk erat di pelukan gadis tersebut, berpadu dengan rambut pirangnya yang halus...)

column1: What is... that?
column2: Apa... itu?

column1: (Igla's footsteps came to a complete halt.)
column2: (Langkah Igla berhenti sepenuhnya.)

column1: (In her neural cloud, it seemed more erroneous fragments were emerging.)
column2: (Di neural cloud-nya, sepertinya makin banyak pecahan galat yang bermunculan.)

column1: (Blurry figures, blonde curls, dolls, a mansion, a laboratory...)
column2: (Figur-figur yang kabur, ikal pirang, boneka, rumah besar, laboratorium...)

column1: Who... is it?
column2: Siapa... itu?

column1: (A faint human voice seems to echo in her Neural cloud, attracting Igla and making her involuntarily want to continue tracing back to the bottom of her Neural cloud.)
column2: (Suara manusia yang samar seolah bergaung di Neural cloud-nya, menarik Igla dan membuatnya tanpa sadar ingin terus menelusuri sampai ke dasar Neural cloud-nya.)

column1: (However, when she reaches the bottom, there seems to be nothing there, only the lingering smell of coolant and a wasteland left after the data was wiped clean.)
column2: (Namun saat dia sampai di dasarnya, sepertinya tidak ada apa-apa di sana, hanya sisa bau cairan pendingin dan tanah tandus yang tertinggal setelah datanya dihapus bersih.)

column1: (Bang!)
column2: (Dor!)

column1: (Bang! Bang!)
column2: (Dor! Dor!)

column1: (The sudden sound of gunfire interrupts Igla's deep thoughts once again.)
column2: (Bunyi tembakan yang tiba-tiba kembali memotong lamunan dalam Igla.)

column1: (Immediately after, the members of Mangi Security rush past her along with the bullets, completely surrounding the squad she had already disarmed.)
column2: (Sesaat kemudian, anggota Mangi Security melesat melewatinya bersama proyektilnya, sepenuhnya mengepung regu yang sudah dia lucuti senjatanya.)

column1: (No one cares about Igla's momentary lapse in concentration, nor does anyone pay attention to her battle results. Only deliberately lowered, disdainful voices sound softly in Igla's ears.)
column2: (Tidak ada yang peduli pada hilangnya konsentrasi Igla sesaat tadi, tidak ada juga yang memperhatikan hasil tempurnya. Hanya suara-suara merendahkan yang sengaja dipelankan berbunyi lirih di telinga Igla.)

column1: Tch, crashing at the drop of a hat. Looks like this consortium's third-generation Dolls aren't that great either.
column2: Cih, gampang sekali nge-crash. Kelihatannya Doll generasi ketiga konsorsium ini juga tidak hebat-hebat amat.

column1: Maybe her brain got fried from being brainwashed.
column2: Mungkin otaknya gosong gara-gara dicuci.

column1: Who told Commander Lentine not to trust Dolls, let alone a Doll originally belonging to the Girard Group...
column2: Siapa suruh Commander Lentine tidak memercayai Doll, apalagi Doll yang aslinya milik Girard Group...

column1: <size=20>Keep your voice down. Don't let her hear you.</size>
column2: <size=20>Kecilkan suaramu. Jangan sampai dia mendengarmu.</size>

column1: What are you afraid of? With her looking like she could crash at any moment, what could she remember?
column2: Kau takut apa? Dengan keadaannya yang bisa nge-crash kapan saja, memangnya dia bisa ingat apa?

column1: Hurry up and work, we can finish once this side is cleaned up...
column2: Cepat kerja, kita bisa selesai begitu sisi ini dibersihkan...

column1: (Creak—)
column2: (Kriet—)

column1: (A few days later, under dim lighting, the door to Mangi Security's temporary archives was quietly pushed open.)
column2: (Beberapa hari kemudian, di bawah pencahayaan yang remang, pintu arsip sementara Mangi Security didorong terbuka tanpa suara.)

column1: (A blonde Doll in red moved silently to the data query terminal, but fell silent facing the screen. She hadn't received any "orders" to investigate, yet some inexplicable instinct still drove her to briefly break free from the constraints of her "orders" and come here.)
column2: (Seorang Doll pirang berpakaian merah bergerak tanpa suara ke terminal pencarian data, tapi terdiam menghadap layarnya. Dia tidak menerima "perintah" apa pun untuk menyelidiki, tapi semacam insting yang tak bisa dijelaskan tetap mendorongnya sejenak lepas dari kekangan "perintah" dan datang kemari.)

column1: (What should I... investigate...)
column2: (Apa yang harus... kuselidiki...)

column1: (Igla subconsciously closed her eyes, recalling.)
column2: (Tanpa sadar Igla menutup matanya, mengingat-ingat.)

column1: (Everything in her neural cloud was still shattered and chaotic, but since the neural cloud wipe stopped, it seemed that some fragments of the past were gradually emerging messily from all over her neural cloud along with the recent engagements.)
column2: (Semua yang ada di neural cloud-nya masih berkeping dan kacau, tapi sejak penghapusan neural cloud dihentikan, sepertinya beberapa pecahan masa lalu berangsur muncul berantakan dari seluruh neural cloud-nya seiring pertempuran belakangan ini.)

column1: (And among the fragments, that unidentified blonde girl appeared with the highest frequency.)
column2: (Dan di antara pecahan-pecahan itu, gadis pirang tak dikenal itu muncul paling sering.)

column1: (Igla's fingers stopped on the keyboard.)
column2: (Jari Igla berhenti di atas papan ketik.)

column1: (She instinctively wanted to look up that girl, but no matter what, she couldn't remember the search keywords.)
column2: (Secara insting dia ingin mencari gadis itu, tapi bagaimanapun juga dia tidak bisa mengingat kata kuncinya.)

column1: (Who... is she?)
column2: (Siapa... dia?)

column1: (What connection... does she have with me?)
column2: (Apa kaitannya... dengan diriku?)

column1: (The query page emitted a pale light. Igla's fingers hesitated for a long time, ultimately remaining stiffly suspended.)
column2: (Halaman pencariannya memancarkan cahaya pucat. Jari Igla ragu lama sekali, dan akhirnya tetap menggantung kaku.)

column1: (Even though a strong desire to investigate surged within her neural cloud and frame, the keywords regarding the girl were completely empty.)
column2: (Meski hasrat kuat untuk menyelidiki menyembur di neural cloud dan frame-nya, kata kunci tentang gadis itu benar-benar kosong.)

column1: (...I can't remember... her name.)
column2: (...Aku tidak bisa mengingat... namanya.)

column1: (Igla remained silent for a long time.)
column2: (Igla terdiam lama sekali.)

column1: (It wasn't until a flashback of a certain record from traveling with Mangi Security a few days ago that Igla's long-hovering fingers finally began to dance across the keyboard.)
column2: (Baru setelah satu rekaman ingatan dari perjalanannya bersama Mangi Security beberapa hari lalu berkelebat, jari Igla yang lama menggantung akhirnya mulai menari di papan ketik.)

column1: (They said I was a Doll originally belonging to the Girard Group...)
column2: (Mereka bilang aku Doll yang aslinya milik Girard Group...)

column1: (After the cursor flickered brightly, using "Girard" as the keyword, reports about the Girard Group appeared on the screen one after another. Igla browsed through them almost hungrily, wanting to record all that intelligence—)
column2: (Setelah kursornya berkelip terang, dengan "Girard" sebagai kata kunci, laporan tentang Girard Group muncul satu demi satu di layar. Igla menelusurinya nyaris dengan lapar, ingin merekam seluruh intel itu—)

column1: (Girard Group collapses...)
column2: (Girard Group runtuh...)

column1: (Cecht FABN replaces its position in Odesa...)
column2: (Cecht FABN menggantikan posisinya di Odesa...)

column1: (Girard Group remnants, Oleg Girard initiates the 'Paradise Project' in Lviv...)
column2: (Sisa-sisa Girard Group, Oleg Girard memulai 'Paradise Project' di Lviv...)

column1: (When browsing this information, it was as if an important switch was finally touched, and more data fragments surged uncontrollably from the bottom of Igla's neural cloud.)
column2: (Saat menelusuri informasi itu, seolah sebuah sakelar penting akhirnya tersentuh, dan lebih banyak pecahan data menyembur tanpa kendali dari dasar neural cloud Igla.)

column1: (Although under the influence of the neural cloud wipe, Igla still cannot understand the meaning of those fragments, the inexplicable sense of familiarity, as well as the faint trembling of the Boojum cells in her frame, still make Igla sense that something is wrong.)
column2: (Meski karena pengaruh penghapusan neural cloud Igla tetap tidak bisa memahami makna pecahan-pecahan itu, rasa akrab yang tak bisa dijelaskan, serta getaran samar sel Boojum di frame-nya, tetap membuat Igla merasa ada yang tidak beres.)

column1: (Why... do I know so much about this information...)
column2: (Kenapa... aku begitu tahu banyak soal informasi ini...)

column1: (She continuously taps the keyboard, speeding up her browsing, trying to devour all the intelligence regarding the Lviv incident. But even after quickly browsing through the relevant intelligence, the faint sense of incongruity in her neural cloud never disappears.)
column2: (Dia terus mengetuk papan ketiknya, mempercepat penelusurannya, mencoba melahap semua intel soal insiden Lviv. Tapi bahkan setelah cepat menelusuri intel terkaitnya, rasa janggal yang samar di neural cloud-nya tidak pernah hilang.)

column1: (Why... is there no... 'her'?)
column2: (Kenapa... tidak ada... 'dia'?)

column1: (Even though she can feel the connection between that girl and herself, for some reason, no trace of that girl can be found in all the intelligence about Lviv.)
column2: (Meski dia bisa merasakan kaitan antara gadis itu dan dirinya, entah kenapa tidak ada jejak gadis itu yang bisa ditemukan di seluruh intel soal Lviv.)

column1: (But precisely because of this, everything seems even more bizarre.)
column2: (Tapi justru karena itu, semuanya terasa makin ganjil.)

column1: (Even though all the information fits perfectly, why is she so certain that the girl is the person most closely related to the Lviv incident?)
column2: (Meski semua informasinya cocok dengan sempurna, kenapa dia begitu yakin gadis itu orang yang paling erat kaitannya dengan insiden Lviv?)

column1: (It's as if the world's massive machine is still running, while the girl and herself have become discarded fragments and gears that cannot mesh.)
column2: (Seolah mesin raksasa dunia ini tetap berjalan, sementara gadis itu dan dirinya jadi pecahan dan roda gigi buangan yang tidak bisa bertaut.)

column1: (What exactly is going on here—)
column2: (Sebenarnya apa yang terjadi di sini—)
（Kriet——）

column1: (The door to the archives suddenly opens, and the red-haired girl strides briskly toward the data console, only to jump back half a step, startled by the figure standing in the dim light.)
column2: (Pintu arsip itu tiba-tiba terbuka, dan gadis berambut merah melangkah cepat ke arah konsol data, lalu melompat mundur setengah langkah karena terkejut oleh figur yang berdiri di cahaya remang itu.)

column1: Whoa! Who's there?!
column2: Wah! Siapa di situ?!

column1: (The girl shook her tomato-red head, patted her chest, and gasped for a few breaths before slowly calming down, opening her eyes wide with some hesitation.)
column2: (Gadis itu menggeleng dengan kepala merah tomatnya, menepuk dadanya, dan menarik beberapa napas sebelum perlahan tenang, membuka matanya lebar-lebar dengan sedikit ragu.)

column1: Igla...? It's so late, what are you looking up here?
column2: Igla...? Sudah selarut ini, kau mencari apa di sini?

column1: (Igla doesn't answer, just quickly clears the search history.)
column2: (Igla tidak menjawab, hanya cepat menghapus riwayat pencariannya.)

column1: Eh? Did I disturb you?
column2: Eh? Apa aku mengganggumu?

column1: Um, next time if it's a combat intelligence question, you can just ask me directly!
column2: Emm, lain kali kalau soal intel tempur, kau bisa langsung tanya padaku!

column1: (Still silent, Igla gives the girl a slight nod and turns to walk out.)
column2: (Tetap diam, Igla memberi gadis itu anggukan kecil lalu berbalik keluar.)

column1: (—Even though this enthusiastic and lively girl seems to have a different temperament from that cold Officer Lentine, Igla has no intention of trusting the girl at all.)
column2: (—Meski gadis yang bersemangat dan lincah itu tampak berbeda watak dari Officer Lentine yang dingin, Igla sama sekali tidak berniat memercayainya.)

column1: (Now, Igla will only trust herself.)
column2: (Sekarang Igla hanya akan memercayai dirinya sendiri.)

column1: (This brief moment of clarity was hard-won, and the next "order" that would make her lose herself could arrive at any time. Until then, she must remain patient, remain obedient, and keep her neural cloud from being wiped again.)
column2: (Momen kejernihan yang singkat ini didapat dengan susah payah, dan "perintah" berikutnya yang akan membuatnya kehilangan diri bisa datang kapan saja. Sampai saat itu, dia harus tetap sabar, tetap menurut, dan menjaga neural cloud-nya agar tidak dihapus lagi.)

column1: (Because she was certain that the missing fragments related to the girl and her own past were buried deep within her neural cloud.)
column2: (Karena dia yakin pecahan yang hilang terkait gadis itu dan masa lalunya sendiri terkubur dalam di neural cloud-nya.)

column1: (And this time, she was determined to retrieve them.)
column2: (Dan kali ini dia bertekad mengambilnya kembali.)
